title: Sofas & Sectionals
lead: Deep, cushioned sofas, curved and modular pieces, and sectionals in chaise, corner and U shapes.
intro: Every sofa has a number, like Sofa No. 07. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.

models.name: Pillow-Arm Deep Sofa
models.summary: A white sofa with deep, soft cushions and low arms topped with loose pillows.
models.more: It is shown as a sofa and as chaise, corner and U-shaped sectionals, all in white.

models.name: Plump-Cushion Sofa
models.summary: A white sofa with plump seat and back cushions, with a square or a softly sloped arm.
models.more: Choose the square arm or the sloped arm, as a sofa or a chaise or U-shaped sectional.

models.name: Track-Arm Sofa
models.summary: A tailored sofa with square track arms and low wood block feet.
models.more: It comes with two or three seat cushions, and as chaise and U-shaped sectionals, shown in light gray and oatmeal.

models.name: Low Square-Arm Sofa
models.summary: A long, low sofa with a square or sloped arm, on wood feet or skirted to the floor.
models.more: The arm comes square or sloped, and the base tailored on wood feet or skirted to the floor.

models.name: Lumbar-Pillow Sofa
models.summary: A linen-look sofa with a bench seat and long lumbar pillows along the back.
models.more: It comes with square or sloped arms, tailored or skirted, as sectionals and as a sleeper sofa.

models.name: Deep Modular Sofa
models.summary: A deep sofa with wide low arms and loose back cushions, made in modular pieces.
models.more: The modular pieces make long, curved or U-shaped sectionals, shown in oatmeal and cream.

models.name: Rounded Reclining Sofa
models.summary: A cream sofa built from soft, rounded blocks, with seats that recline.
models.more: The seats recline with pull-out footrests, as a sofa or a corner sectional.

models.name: Channel-Back Reclining Sofa
models.summary: A cream reclining sofa with horizontal channels across the back.
models.more: The seats recline, and it also comes as a sectional with a curved corner.

models.name: Low Platform Sofa
models.summary: A low camel sofa with wide flat arms that work as ledges, on a slim plinth.
models.more: The wide arms double as ledges, and it comes as chaise, corner and U-shaped sectionals.

models.name: Built-In Arm Sofa
models.summary: A camel sofa with high square arms set flush with the back and one long bench cushion.
models.more: It is shown as a sofa and as corner and U-shaped sectionals in camel.

models.name: Rounded-End Sofa
models.summary: A cream sofa whose rounded ends wrap around a long bench seat.
models.more: There is also a U-shaped version with a rounded chaise at each end.

models.name: Serpentine Curved Sofa
models.summary: A camel sofa with a gently curved back, on a dark recessed base.
models.more: It comes as a sofa, a chaise sofa and as crescent and curved sectionals.

models.name: Pebble Modular Sofa
models.summary: Rounded, pebble-shaped seat pieces with separate back pads, joined in gentle curves.
models.more: The rounded pieces join in curved runs, with the back pads placed along the top.

models.name: Slim-Arm Sofa on Legs
models.summary: A white sofa with slim sloped arms, raised on slim legs.
models.more: It is shown in white on slim legs and in gray on wood legs, as a sofa and as sectionals.

models.name: Bouclé-Look Sofa
models.summary: A cream sofa in a textured bouclé-look fabric, with low rounded arms.
models.more: It comes as a sofa and as chaise and corner sectionals, in textured cream.

models.name: Sculpted Curve Sofa
models.summary: A camel sofa where the back and arms form one flowing curve.
models.more: It comes with a straight or wave-shaped back, and as an asymmetric chaise sofa.

models.name: Rolled-Arm Plinth Sofa
models.summary: A camel sofa with round rolled arms, on a slim plinth.
models.more: It also comes as chaise and U-shaped sectionals with the same rolled arms.

models.name: Biscuit-Tufted Sofa
models.summary: A low sofa covered in square biscuit tufting on the seat, back and arms.
models.more: It comes as a sofa and as modular chaise, corner and U-shaped sectionals.

models.name: Grid-Stitched Low Sofa
models.summary: A low camel sofa with square stitching across the seat and back.
models.more: It is made in modular pieces for long runs and U-shaped sectionals.

models.name: Block Modular Sofa
models.summary: A low modular sofa with block arms and loose seat cushions.
models.more: It is shown in cream and gray, as a sofa and as long, corner and U-shaped sectionals.

models.name: Wraparound-Back Sofa
models.summary: A camel sofa whose rounded back curves down into the arms, with a slim outlined edge.
models.more: The rounded back wraps into the arms, outlined in a slim edge.

models.name: Feather-Pillow Sofa
models.summary: A cream sofa with loose, flange-edged back pillows and slightly sloped arms.
models.more: It comes as a sofa and as chaise and U-shaped sectionals, in cream or white.

models.name: Bolster Curved Sofa
models.summary: A white curved sofa in a bouclé-look fabric, with round bolster pillows on small wood feet.
models.more: It sits on small wood feet, with round bolsters along the curved back.

models.name: Deep Low-Arm Sofa
models.summary: A sofa with thin low arms, a very deep seat and two large back cushions.
models.more: It comes as a sofa and as chaise and corner sectionals, in cream or white.

models.name: Buttoned Bouclé-Look Loveseat
models.summary: A small cream loveseat in a bouclé-look fabric, with a buttoned back and flared arms.
models.more: The flared arms and buttoned back sit on splayed wood legs.
